dorapack mod (MC 1.12.2 Forge, com.dorapack, mod_id=dorapack) at D:/ideaProJect/magi-tech-integration: Completed P3C review + unit tests. Build JDK: export JAVA_HOME=~/.jdks/temurin-25.0.3; mod targets Java 8. Full `./gradlew.bat build` SUCCESSFUL, produces build/libs/dorapack-1.0.0.jar. NOTE: `clean` can fail because build/rfg/recompiled_minecraft jar gets locked by another process — run `build` without `clean`. Validate JSON assets with node (python not reliably on PATH): 92 asset JSONs all valid.

P3C fixes applied: TileDoorHubCore.isOwner null-owner bug (now returns false); PacketResearchAction hardened untrusted ByteBuf reads (MAX_ITEM_KEY_LENGTH=256, floorMod for tier ordinal); PacketSyncPlayerData now applies pointsToday (added setPointsGainedToday to IDoraPlayerData interface + impl @Override); EntityFairy readEntityFromNBT guards KEY_REMAINING (avoided instant-death default 0); RobotUpgrade.byId uses Objects.equals; CapabilityRegistrar uses Constants.NBT.TAG_* instead of magic 8/10; RobotStats/RobotMiningTask/RobotInventoryAdapter magic numbers -> named constants.

Refactor for testability: ResearchManager and AchievementManager now have data-only overloads operating on IDoraPlayerData (POJO DoraPlayerData) split from EntityPlayer/messaging shells. AchievementManager.progress(IDoraPlayerData,key,amount) returns points granted or -1.

Unit tests: src/test/java/com/dorapack/dorapack/ - 5 files, 38 tests, all pass. DoraPlayerDataTest, ResearchManagerTest, AchievementManagerTest, RobotStatsTest, MiscLogicTest. Tests reset DoraConfig static defaults in @BeforeEach (config only loads Forge Configuration at load()-time, defaults are literals so usable in tests).
